claims.statement: AmplifierCensus.eq5_unique: for any adjacency A on Fin n, if v solves Allen eq. (5) (zero diagonal, tau_ij = 1 + 1/2 sum_k (p_ik tau_jk + p_jk tau_ik)) and v_ij > 0 for i != j, then every rational solution tau of eq. (5) equals v. Proof by a maximum principle (diff_nonpos).

AmplifierCensus.R11_amplifier: on the 11-vertex graph GR11 (graph6 J?ouPjI[@i?, degrees 3,4,...,4,3, symmetric and loopless as checked by GR11_symm, GR11_loopless, GR11_deg), every rational solution tau of Allen eq. (5) satisfies neff GR11 tau = 2668552698098/242579025123 and 11 < neff GR11 tau. The statement is about the linear system (eqs. 5, 6, 9) over Q; it does not formalise the Markov chain or eq. (8).
AmplifierCensus.P11_isothermal (positive control): on the 4-regular parent GP11 (graph6 J?ouPjI{@i?) every solution of eq. (5) has neff = 11 exactly.

Lean controls: ctl_perturbed_vector_rejected (one tau entry changed by 1/D is not a solution of eq. (5) on GR11), ctl_perturbed_graph_rejected (the R11 certificate is not a solution on the parent GP11), ctl_parent_not_amplifier (no solution on GP11 has 11 < neff) are kernel-checked with axioms within the allowlist; the planted ctl_sorry reports sorryAx and the planted ctl_axiom reports AmplifierCensusControls.ctl_cheat; ControlsMustFail.lean (asks the kernel to accept the perturbed vector) fails to compile with rc 1.

Allen et al. (arXiv 1906.01036v1 = PLoS Comput. Biol. 16(1):e1007529): model (connected undirected unweighted graph without loops, death-Birth updating, one mutant at a uniformly random vertex, fitness r = 1 + delta), coalescence-time equations (5), remeeting times (6), identity (7), N_eff = sum pi_i tau_i (9), and the definition: G is an amplifier of weak selection iff N_eff > N, a suppressor iff N_eff < N.

Allen et al. eq. (8): rho_G(1+delta) = 1/N + delta (N_eff - 2)/(2N) + O(delta^2); hence N_eff > N implies rho_G(r) > rho_{K_N}(r) for r in (1, b) for some b > 1 and rho_G < rho_K on (a, 1); N_eff = N decides nothing at first order.

Enumeration: nauty geng 2.7r3 (geng -c N) yields 2, 6, 21, 112, 853, 11117, 261080, 11716571 connected graphs for N = 3..10, equal to OEIS A001349 read on 2026-10-27. Completeness rests on geng and on this count check; it is not kernel-checked.

Census: among all connected simple graphs with 3 <= N <= 10, none has N_eff > N and every regular one has N_eff = N exactly; N_eff < N for all others (counts 1/1, 2/4, 2/19, 5/107, 4/849, 17/11100, 22/261058, 167/11716404 for eq/lt at N = 3..10). Method: float64 LAPACK proposal; exact int64 residual of the integer system 2 k_i k_j * eq. (5); inverse of I - M is non-negative so the residual bounds the error (|tau - t/2^30| <= eps tau_max); exclusion only if N_eff_hat + eps tau_max < N in exact integers; every non-excluded graph (exactly the regular graphs) solved with Fractions. Largest eps 5.9e-8; smallest certified gap among non-regular graphs 0.0174 (N = 9). NOT kernel-checked.

Independent implementation (code/exact_census.py, pure-Fraction Gauss-Jordan on eqs. (5), (6), (9), no identity and no enclosure) on all 12,111 connected graphs with N <= 8 agrees with the enclosure census on every count and every classification.

Regular graphs: counts 1, 2, 2, 5, 4, 17, 22, 167 for N = 3..10 equal OEIS A005177 (connected regular graphs), so none is missing; each has N_eff = N exactly (Fraction solve). Complete graphs and cycles N = 3..10 have N_eff = N.

Nearest non-regular graphs: for N = 4..10 the non-regular graph with the smallest certified gap N - N_eff is nearly complete (even N: K_N minus one edge; odd N: K_N minus a maximum matching; e.g. 173/45 at N = 4, 291/49 at N = 6, 2653/333 at N = 8, 719/146 at N = 5, 5038/723 at N = 7); the certified lower bounds on the gap are 0.1556, 0.0753, 0.0612, 0.0318, 0.0330, 0.0174, 0.0207. Observation for N <= 10; no proof for general N. The N_eff values of the odd/even cases at N = 9, 10 are floating-point readings (8.98262, 9.97927).

Exact-chain slope control: d rho/dr at r = 1 of the exact 2^N-2 state death-Birth chain equals (N_eff - 2)/(2N) on every connected graph with N = 3..6 and on every 40th graph with N = 7 (163 graphs); the edge identity N_eff = 1 + (1/m) sum_{ij in E} tau_ij and Allen eq. (7) hold on all 994 connected graphs with 3 <= N <= 7. This checks the transcription of the criterion, not eq. (8) itself for larger N.

Allen eq. (3) as printed in arXiv v1 (cycle fixation probability with r^{-(N-1)}) disagrees with the exact chain in 25 of 25 cases; three other sources (Kaveh et al. eq. (20) at d = 1, Hindersin-Traulsen SI eq. (18), Richter eq. (12): 2(r-1)/(3r-1+(r-3)r^{2-N})) agree with the chain. Presented neutrally; not confirmed with the authors; the criterion eq. (9) used here does not depend on eq. (3).

Other controls (positive): K_N and C_N have N_eff = N; star S_n has N_eff = 4n/(n+1) for n = 2..9; dB and Bd closed forms on K_N, the dB cycle and the dB star agree with the exact chain at r in {3/4, 5/4, 3/2, 7/4, 1001/1000}, N = 3..7; Hindersin-Traulsen N = 4 classification reproduced; stars S_4..S_6 are Bd amplifiers and dB suppressors on the r grid. (Negative): p_ij = 1/k_j breaks the star value 10/3; K_N never passes N_eff > N; the Antal approximation N mu_1^2/mu_2 <= N on every connected graph with N <= 7 and so cannot detect an amplifier; edges removed away from the argmax vertex of Richter's parents give N_eff <= 10.8805 (N = 11) and <= 11.9337 (N = 12).

Richter reproduction: among the 265 connected quartic graphs on 11 vertices exactly one parent (J?ouPjI{@i?) is an amplifier constructor; all four edge removals at its argmax vertex give N_eff = 2668552698098/242579025123 = 11.000756 (printed 11.0008). Cubic N = 12 (85 graphs): one constructor, two removals give 12.026644 (printed 12.0266).

Unexplained discrepancy: Richter prints tau_max = 17.6997 for the N = 11 parent and 18.2911 for the N = 12 cubic example; the exact values here are 10066/569 = 17.69069 and 23648139127685/1292664631282 = 18.29410. The N_eff values agree to the printed digits. Could be a typo or a convention difference; not raised with the author; no second independent check.

Finite-r signs on the N = 11 graph (J?ouPjI[@i?) against K_11 via exact-rational a-posteriori residual bounds on the 2046-state chain: rho_G - rho_K > 0 at r = 10001/10000 and 2501/2500; < 0 at 2499/2500 and 1001/1000; error bound <= 3.3e-14 against differences of 3e-9 to 2e-8; T_max <= 242.43. The method was validated on the star S_5 at r = 5/4 and 1001/1000. Python Fractions, not kernel-checked.

Bisection of the sign of rho_G - rho_K between r = 1.0007 (positive) and r = 1.00085 (negative) gives a certified sign change in [10248431/10240000, 4099373/4096000] = [1.00082334, 1.00082349]; the signs along the bisection are alternately positive and negative, each certified. Existence of at least one change in the bracket is certified; uniqueness of the crossing is not shown.

For all 212 connected non-complete regular graphs with 4 <= N <= 10, rho_G(r) < rho_{K_N}(r) is certified at both r = 999/1000 and r = 1001/1000 (none above K_N, none undecided). This is not a proof for all r near 1: Allen et al. p. 21 list it as an open question.

HEADLINE. No connected simple unweighted graph with at most ten vertices is an amplifier of weak selection for death-Birth updating (N_eff > N, Allen et al.); the 11-vertex graph of Richter is one, with exact N_eff = 2668552698098/242579025123 > 11 for every solution of eq. (5); hence the smallest connected unweighted dB amplifier of weak selection has exactly 11 vertices. Filed C because the census half is C; N = 1, 2 are trivial (K_2 regular). The step from N_eff > N to amplification at finite r near 1 is AMC-L-0002 (literature).

Floating-point ratios rho_G/rho_K - 1 of order 1e-8 to 1e-10 at the evaluated r, and the reading that G is above K on (1, about 1.0008) and below it for r slightly larger; Richter reads r_max about 1.00075 off a figure. Extrapolation between certified points; supports nothing by itself.
Repository guards were NOT run for this paper (antigravity_guard.py, test_rigor_guard.py, pytest tests/): no output exists, and none is claimed. Recorded so the absence is explicit.
